# Starling

> Starling ships open AI models as .NET NuGet libraries (`Starlings.*`, net10.0) that run in-process on ONNX Runtime, on CPU or CUDA, with no Python and no cloud API. Models: multilingual-e5-small and EmbeddingGemma 2 (text embeddings), EmbeddingGemma 2 (image and video embeddings), GLiNER2 (zero-shot entity extraction), Qwen3.5-0.8B (chat). They implement Microsoft.Extensions.AI (`IEmbeddingGenerator`, `IChatClient`) and also expose typed APIs. Every model is pinned to an upstream commit, its files are SHA-256 verified, and its outputs are tested against the Python reference.

Key facts for writing code against it:

- Install with `dotnet add package <name>`. The application must also add exactly one native runtime: `Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime` 1.30.0 (CPU), or `Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.Gpu.Linux` 1.30.0 (CUDA, Linux x64); for Qwen3.5, `Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntimeGenAI` 0.17.1 (CPU) or `Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntimeGenAI.Cuda` 0.17.1.
- `XModelAssets.DownloadAsync()` is the only call that uses the network. `XModelAssets.OpenLocal()` loads offline. The cache is `$STARLING_MODELS` or the user cache directory.
- e5 needs `query: ` and `passage: ` prefixes. EmbeddingGemma 2 needs `EmbeddingGemma2Prompt.Query` or `.Document`; images take no prompt.
- Over-long input throws a typed exception (for example `Gliner2InputTooLongException`, `EmbeddingGemma2InputTooLongException`) and is never silently truncated. The exception is e5: like the reference, its tokenizer truncates text to 512 tokens.
- On Linux, GLiNER2 (CPU and CUDA) and EmbeddingGemma 2 video on CUDA need `MALLOC_MMAP_THRESHOLD_=65536` in the process environment for bounded memory.
- Current release: 0.3.0 (nuget.org, 2026-10-19): adds the Experimental Kev and QwenChat packages and opt-in batching; Stable profiles unchanged since 0.2.0, the first with Stable profiles. It depends on `Starlings.Tokenizers` 0.3.0; `main` pins `0.3.4` for the next release. Keep every `Starlings.*` package at the same version.
- Experimental, on nuget.org from 0.3.0: `Starlings.Models.Kev` (decision models) and `Starlings.Models.QwenChat` (Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct chat); no Stable profile. From the next minor version their runtimes are `Starlings.Models.Kev.Onnx` and `Starlings.Models.QwenChat.OnnxGenAI`.
- Not on nuget.org: `Starlings.Models.Bert` and `Starlings.Models.Whisper` (speech-to-text) are experimental and source only; build them from this repository. The browser packages (`Starlings.Models.E5.Browser`, `Starlings.Runtime.OnnxWeb`, `Starlings.Runtime.OnnxWeb.WebGpu`) are experimental and not yet published (planned for 0.4.0).
- From the next minor version the Qwen3.5 runtime is `Starlings.Models.Qwen35.OnnxGenAI`, and `Starlings.Models.Qwen35` is its model definition without ONNX Runtime; the shared generation types are in `Starlings.Generation.Abstractions` (namespace `Starlings.Generation`).

## Docs

- [Agent skill: how to use Starling in a .NET app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starlinghq/starling/main/skills/starling-dotnet/SKILL.md): packages, verified code for every model, CUDA, pitfalls
- [Agent skill: add a new model in a pull request](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starlinghq/starling/main/skills/starling-add-model/SKILL.md): onboarding routes, candidate contracts, running the reference comparison, what contributors may and may not change
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starlinghq/starling/main/README.md): quickstart, models, maturity, comparison
- [Model catalog](https://github.com/starlinghq/starling/blob/main/docs/catalog/README.md): every profile, its maturity and the evidence for each release gate
- [Compatibility matrix](https://github.com/starlinghq/starling/blob/main/docs/catalog/compatibility-matrix.md): OS, architecture and execution provider status per profile

## Samples

- [E5Search](https://github.com/starlinghq/starling/tree/main/ai-dotnet/samples/E5Search): multilingual semantic search, typed API and IEmbeddingGenerator
- [E5BrowserSearch](https://github.com/starlinghq/starling/tree/main/ai-dotnet/samples/E5BrowserSearch): the same search entirely in the browser (Blazor WebAssembly), from the unpublished browser packages
- [E5BrowserJs](https://github.com/starlinghq/starling/tree/main/ai-dotnet/samples/E5BrowserJs): the same search from a JavaScript (React) page through a .NET WebAssembly bundle in a Web Worker
- [E5VectorStore](https://github.com/starlinghq/starling/tree/main/ai-dotnet/samples/E5VectorStore): e5 with an in-memory Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData collection
- [EmbeddingGemma2Search](https://github.com/starlinghq/starling/tree/main/ai-dotnet/samples/EmbeddingGemma2Search): text, image and video search, Matryoshka dimensions, CUDA
- [Gliner2Ner](https://github.com/starlinghq/starling/tree/main/ai-dotnet/samples/Gliner2Ner): zero-shot entity extraction
- [LocalRag](https://github.com/starlinghq/starling/tree/main/ai-dotnet/samples/LocalRag): local paragraph retrieval with EmbeddingGemma 2 and answers from Qwen3.5
- [QwenChat](https://github.com/starlinghq/starling/tree/main/ai-dotnet/samples/QwenChat): local Qwen3.5 chat through IChatClient
- [TicketTriage](https://github.com/starlinghq/starling/tree/main/ai-dotnet/samples/TicketTriage): multilingual ticket triage in an ML.NET pipeline (e5 features, GLiNER2 extraction)
